_comment: Two objects per grid; the SMALLER object is recoloured in place to match the LARGER object's colour (larger unchanged, grid unchanged). Isolates the in-place recolour concept: no object moves. selector=smallest, source=largest. Paired with recolor_to_smallest.json whose selector/source are swapped, so the two anti-unify into one covers>1 object_recolor rule (R3). Value-agnostic: colours/sizes differ across pairs, so the new colour is color_of(largest), never a literal.
